title: Supplication for Protection from Devils during Sleep
arabic: أَعُوْذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللّٰهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ ، وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ ، وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِيْنِ وَأَنْ يَّحْضُرُوْنِ
transliteration: Aʿūdhu bikalimātillāhit-tāmmāti min ghaḍabihi wa ʿiqābih, wa sharri ʿibādih, wa min hamazātish-shayāṭīni wa an yaḥḍurūn
translation: I seek protection in the perfect words of Allah from His anger and punishment, and from the evil of His servants, and from the evil suggestions of the devils and from them appearing to me.
reference: ʿAmr b. Shuʿayb narrated from his father... (Tirmidhī 3528)

title: Supplication to Suffice from Enemies
translation: O Allah, suffice me from them, with what You choose.

title: Supplication for Allah as a Shield Against Evil People
arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِيْ نُحُوْرِهِمْ ، وَنَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُوْرِهِمْ
transliteration: Allāhumma innā najʿaluka fī nuḥūrihim, wa naʿūdhu bika min shurūrihim
translation: O Allah, we make You our shield against them and we seek refuge in You from their evil.
reference: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was apprehensive of [a group] of people, he would say: [the above]. (Abū Dāwūd 1537)

title: Supplication for Allah's Support and Help in Battle
arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ أنْتَ عَضُدِيْ وَأَنْتَ نَصِيْرِيْ ، بِكَ أَحُوْلُ ، وبِكَ أصُوْلُ ، وَبِكَ أُقَاتِلُ
transliteration: Allāhumma anta ʿaḍudī wa anta naṣīrī, bika aḥūl, wa bika aṣūl, wa bika uqātil
translation: O Allah, You are my aid and helper; by You I move, by You I attack, and by You I fight.
reference: Anas b. Mālik (raḍiy Allāhu 'anhu) narrated... (Abū Dāwūd 2632)
